clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for cast iron gratings for use in drainage works.

clauses.title: Materials – Frame and
clauses.text: 2. Materials -  Frame and cover shall be of grey cast iron. Hinge pin shall be of mild steel wire.

clauses.title: Manufacture and Workmanship
clauses.text: 3. Manufacture and Workmanship — Frame and cover shall be free from air and sand holes, cold shuts and warping.

clauses.title: Dimensions and Tolerances
clauses.text: 4. Dimensions and Tolerances Size of frame =  600 × 560 mm (Outside dimensions) Height of frame =  100 mm

clauses.title: Tolerance
clauses.text: 4.1 Tolerance —    On internal dimensions of the top of For  detailed information, refer to IS  5961 : 1970 Specification for cast iron gratings or drainage purposes. SUMMARY OF IS  5961 : 1970 CAST IRON GRATING FOR DRAINAGE PURPOSES the   frame ± 2 mm. Note — For detailed dimensions see Fig. 1 of the  standard.

clauses.title: Coating – Shall be
clauses.text: 6. Coating -  Shall be with a material having tar base with a black bituminous composition. Coating shall be smooth and tenacious which will not flow at a temperature of 63°C, and which is not so brittle as to chip off at 0°C.

clauses.title: Test – Gratings shall
clauses.text: 7. Test -  Gratings shall withstand without fracture a load of 35 tonnes for a minimum period of 30 seconds when subjected to loading test described in IS  1726 : 1991+.
